curious.speaker: Wren
curious.text: You were on the ship, weren't you? The prison one? Mam says convicts are just people who got caught. What did you do?

curious2.speaker: Wren
curious2.text: I won't tell anyone. Honest. Teague says there are things in the fog at night. Do you think he is making it up?

scared.speaker: Wren
scared.text: The big bones are gone. I climbed on them all summer! Pell says nobody took them. If nobody took them, where did they go?
